description:
Idempotently install (or normalize) a single cron schedule that fires `service_interface::session_ledger_service::trigger_poll` every `cadence_minutes` minutes. Mirrors `service_interface::scheduling_service::ensure_global_heartbeat` for the LLM session ledger: clears any existing schedules tagged `ledger:periodic_poll`, then creates one fresh schedule with the requested cadence.

Boot-only — wired via the profile's `starting_actions` so a fresh solet auto-paces her own ledger ingest the moment her services come up. The `is_discoverable=False` flag keeps the verb out of the model's `process_search` results; operator-initiated re-runs go through the operator bridge directly.

The scheduled cron simply enqueues a trigger_poll action on the platform action queue; the importer runs synchronously when the action fires, persists events, and updates per-source cursors. There is no per-cron retry — the next cron tick is the retry path, so a transient backend hiccup won't compound.

Fails fast if scheduling_service is not bound at session_ledger_service construction (a profile that omits scheduling has no business booting this verb).
embedding_description: Boot-time idempotent helper that installs a single periodic-poll cron firing trigger_poll on the LLM session ledger every N minutes. Mirrors ensure_global_heartbeat. Tag: ledger:periodic_poll. Default cadence 5 minutes.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Periodic trigger_poll schedule status — created, already_present, or normalized after duplicate cleanup.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The ledger now auto-polls every configured interval. If you are diagnosing whether ingest is stalled, check `get_import_status` / `list_sessions` rather than re-running this verb.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Ensuring a single periodic trigger_poll cron schedule for the LLM session ledger
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: RuntimeError: scheduling_service not bound (profile omits scheduling). ValueError: cadence_minutes out of the 1..59 range. SchedulerError: scheduling backend rejected the cron expression or refused to clear/create the schedule.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If scheduling is unavailable, the operator can fall back to invoking `trigger_poll` directly from the operator bridge. If cadence validation failed, retry with a value in [1, 59]. If the scheduling backend failed, inspect `get_schedules_by_tag` for stuck duplicates and consider clearing them by tag.
